summary: Move the completed discussion to the Preterit box
before: ono w hiye mǧawablan ʕal aṯe-ste
rationale: The verb mǧawablan has the first-person plural preterit L-ending -lan, whereas a first-person plural Infectum would have a subject ending such as -ina. The accompanying translation explicitly says wir haben ... diskutiert. Retain sense 3 and move the example to Preterit.
